text:
Maya: Quick heads-up — MerchantWorks CTO just paused the POC. Legal flagged our BYOK language and procurement wants exec-level reassurance before signing. Need an internal bridge today to unblock. @Liam can you join?

Jonas: SE note — we can support their KMS flow technically, but contract language needs to be narrowed. They asked for `Section 4.3: Customer key custody` verbatim; legal says that exact wording is a non-starter.

Priya: From presales: timeline risk — they want the 2-week reserved capacity and an isolation promise. Pricing will need a short-term credit/discount to commit.

Avery: Security team flagged two things: key rotation policy + audit log retention. If they insist on BYOK without HSM attestation we need an exception. Prefer HSM-backed KMS or a compensating control.

Maya: The CTO also asked for VP/CTO-level reassurance on indemnity and egress clauses — procurement won't move without that.

Liam: I can hop on a 30m exec bridge at 4pm PT. @LegalBot, can you summarize the delta options we can offer before the bridge? (BYOK addendum, temporary egress limits, or Redwood-managed keys with SLA).

LegalBot: Draft options available to propose:
1) BYOK addendum with attestation + monthly audit report
2) Redwood-managed keys + contractual egress limit and enhanced DPA
3) Interim NDA + expedited DPA escalation for POC
Uploaded: /contracts/byok-addendum-v2.docx

Jonas: Tech caveat — BYOK POC path can be mocked by providing a customer public key + KMS endpoint stub for the demo. Cutover to real KMS requires endpoint + key exchange steps (I can write the stub instructions).

Avery: Also need to confirm network peering ranges. MerchantWorks uses private VPC peering; ops needs the CID blocks before we can promise isolation.

Priya: Ops asked whether we can guarantee reserved GPUs *and* isolated logs for the POC. Ops tentative yes, but they need a confirmed start date and ticket.

Maya: Proposed next steps:
  1) Legal picks option (1/2/3) and posts a short summary we can present to the customer
  2) Ops confirms capacity + log isolation window and posts ticket link
  3) 30m exec bridge at 4pm PT to align on go/no-go
Please ack: @Liam @Avery @Jonas @LegalBot

Liam: Ack — I'll run the bridge, will include the customer CTO.

LegalBot: Reviewing now. Targeting to publish a proposed addendum by 15:30 PT.

Avery: I'll validate HSM attestation docs and post findings by 15:45 PT.

Jonas: I'll draft a 1-page runbook for BYOK stub cutover by 15:50 PT (commands + rollback).

Maya: Thanks — I'll create the calendar invite and include the customer CTO + procurement.

(incident-bot): New ticket created: OPS-4987 — MerchantWorks POC reserved capacity & log isolation.

Maya: Updating thread — if legal posts the addendum by 15:30 we'll present option 1 in the bridge. If not, option 2 is fallback.

Liam: Understood. Prep talking points: risk, mitigation, pricing concession band.

Maya: Closing loop for now — will post bridge invite in ~5m and link docs.
